purpose: Exact symbolic safety condition for abstract relocation of uncorrelated scalar Boolean evaluation through a global aggregate
abstract_before: Global COUNT(n) returns one output row and independently computed scalar Boolean value v in {TRUE,FALSE,NULL} for any n >= 0.
abstract_after: Scalar Boolean v evaluated on each source input row, subsequently recovered with FIRST(v); returns NULL when n=0 and v when n>0.
logical_formula: Correct iff (n>0) OR (v=NULL); counterexample n=0 and v=TRUE/FALSE.
proof_demands: Without any guard, SMT must return SAT, with witness n=0,v=TRUE or FALSE
Under precondition n>0, SMT must return UNSAT
Under precondition v=NULL, SMT must return UNSAT
Under guard n>0 OR v=NULL, SMT must return UNSAT
Under weaker guard n>=0 alone, still SAT
Exact safety condition must agree with enumerated finite n=0,1,2 and all three Boolean v values.
